gates.evidence: The proposal targets settings and feature upsells on the Luzia settings screen, which is SFW and age-appropriate.
The reward is an in-app time-boxed feature unlock; no cash or clicks are incentivized.
The proposal uses gain framing (unlock a sample) rather than hostage framing.
The offer uses a clear 'Play to try' button with an explicit 'No thanks' decline.
The offer states 'Play a 15-second game to unlock 30 minutes of Upgrade to Luzia+ today.'
The 'No thanks' button allows the user to dismiss the offer and continue without penalty.
The offer appears on the Settings screen (s19), away from streaming conversational responses.
